pre_observation_proof.reason_amendment_is_permitted: The original one-year/220-date stopping choice was reviewed before any prospective source observation and found underpowered. This amendment is based only on the already-known retrospective effect and HAC uncertainty, not on prospective data.

power_calculation.planning_source: already-known historical reconstruction result; used for design only, not confirmatory evidence
power_calculation.planning_caveat: This is only a planning approximation. The retrospective effect may be optimistic and future dependence may differ; therefore the design uses an additional capture buffer and does not claim guaranteed power.

superseded_fields.stopping_and_peeking.first_primary_judgm: fixed one-year window plus H20 maturity

replacement_stopping_rule.preoutcome_pass_definition: signal date has immutable FORWARD_COLLECTED_VENDOR_SNAPSHOT Broker lineage and PASS_PROSPECTIVE_PREOUTCOME_INPUT_FROZEN under the frozen U100/control rules, before any forward outcome is loaded
replacement_stopping_rule.stop_source_accrual: Stop adding confirmatory signal dates immediately after the 450th preoutcome-pass signal date. Do not extend because interim or final outcomes look weak or strong.
replacement_stopping_rule.judge_open_time: Only after the 450th preoutcome-pass signal date has been frozen and every one of those 450 dates has either matured H20 or failed a predeclared outcome-data-quality gate.
replacement_stopping_rule.if_final_primary_eligible_below_400: DATA_OR_LINEAGE_INVALID_STOP; no confirmatory alpha conclusion and no outcome-driven extension of the sample.
